name: Muralha Contra Impacto
note:
<Hide State Turns>
<State Tooltip Description>
 O aliado fica imune a dano. Kilin absorve todo o dano em seu lugar ate o proximo turno de Kilin.
</State Tooltip Description>
<JS Pre-Damage as Target>
var kilin = $gameParty.battleMembers().find(function(m) {
  return m._actorId === 5;
});
if (kilin && kilin.isAlive()) {
  kilin.gainHp(-value);
  kilin.gainTp(Math.floor(value / 20));
  kilin._bodyguardIntercept = true;
  value = 1;
}
</JS Pre-Damage as Target>
<Positive State>

name: Muralha Tracker
note:
<Hide State Turns>
<JS On Expire State>
var allies = $gameParty.battleMembers();
for (var i = 0; i < allies.length; i++) {
  if (allies[i].isStateAffected(85)) {
    allies[i].eraseState(85);
  }
}
</JS On Expire State>
